properties.site-address: Bank Hall, Bank Hall Drive, Bretherton
properties.notes: Development of the site had not started in April 2017. The conversion of Bank Hall into 12 dwellings is expected to start in the next few months. The 23 new build dwellings are expected to commence following completion of the conversion. It is predicted that all of these dwellings will be completed in the five year period.. Refurbishment of Bank Hall into 12 dwellings. Enabling development is the erection of 23 dwellings on the former orchard site but this is not on brownfield land.
